set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family ethernet-switching interface-mode.explanation: Configures the interface with trunk exchange mode.

family ethernet-switching vlan members [.explanation: Configure the VLAN members of the interface.

set chassis fpc [parameter1].explanation: Sets the specified parameter for a Flexible PIC Concentrator (FPC) in the Junos chassis, configuring hardware-specific behavior or operational state.

pic [parameter2].explanation: This command configures a Flexible PIC Concentrator (FPC) and its associated Physical Interface Card (PIC) in a Junos device, specifying parameters for hardware settings.

flexe-group [parameter3].explanation: The command `flexe-group [parameter3]` configures a FlexE (Flexible Ethernet) group interface, where `[parameter3]` specifies the group ID or related parameters for the FlexE interface.

sub-time-slot granularity [parameter4].explanation: The command `sub-time-slot granularity [parameter4]` configures the granularity of sub-time slots in Junos, allowing precise control over time-division multiplexing (TDM) resource allocation.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.explanation: Sub-time slot particle size, for example 1g.

binding interface [parameter4].explanation: The command `binding interface [parameter4]` binds a specified interface (`[parameter4]`) to a service or configuration context in Junos.

flexe-group-num [parameter5].explanation: The command `flexe-group-num [parameter5]` configures a FlexE (Flexible Ethernet) group by assigning a specific group number (`[parameter5]`) to it.

flexe-client [parameter3].explanation: The `flexe-client [parameter3]` command in Junos configures a FlexE (Flexible Ethernet) client interface, specifying parameters like bandwidth or client ID for flexible Ethernet services.

flexe-group [parameter4].explanation: The `flexe-group [parameter4]` command in Junos configures a FlexE (Flexible Ethernet) group, where `[parameter4]` specifies the group identifier or related parameters for FlexE interface aggregation.

flexe-type [parameter5].explanation: The `flexe-type [parameter5]` command in Junos configures the FlexE (Flexible Ethernet) interface type, specifying the FlexE client or group using the provided parameter.

port-id [parameter6].explanation: The `port-id [parameter6]` command in Junos specifies the port identifier for a specific interface or service, using `parameter6` to define the exact port or value.

bandwidth [parameter7].explanation: The `bandwidth [parameter7]` command in Junos sets the interface's bandwidth to the specified value in kilobits per second (kbps) for routing and QoS calculations.

client-id [parameter8].explanation: The command `client-id [parameter8]` in Junos specifies a unique identifier for a DHCP client, using `[parameter8]` as the client's ID value.
